aspect: Hours are income for hourly workers
description: Cutting somebody from forty hours to eighteen is a pay cut administered without any process, and appeals against a rota do not exist.
energy_note: A pay cut with no letter and no appeal.

description: Declining the day of the wedding, the funeral or the hospital appointment is operational discretion, and repeated refusal is still operational discretion.
energy_note: Refused the day that mattered, lawfully.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the rota on the wall
description: She asked, once, whether the new starter was being paid more. The following month she has four closing shifts and both weekend days. 'Business needs. It moves around.' It does not move back.
energy_note: One question in March, and a different roster from April.

description: Unpredictable scheduling is uniquely damaging to anyone with childcare or caring duties, which means the instrument is gendered in effect without being gendered in form.
energy_note: Neutral on paper, aimed in practice.
